newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee opens steady, RBI seen propping dollar.
newsitem.headline: India rupee opens steady, RBI seen propping dollar.

text.p: * The Indian rupee opens steady at 35.81/82 against the dollar on Friday, dealers say.
* The rupee seen moving in a narrow groove on Friday.
* No significant dollar demand expected on Friday.
* The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) seen defending the dollar at 35.81/82 level as evident from its purchases over a week.
* The RBI bought dollars on Thursday at 35.82, though many in the market not aware of this, chief dealer at a bank says.
* Sharp deceleration in Indian exports may be dictating RBI intervention at 35.82 levels, some dealers speculate.
* Forward dollar premiums seen soft as forward dollar sellers abound and buyers become scarce, dealers say.
